verdict: Yes, for a founder close to transplant medicine. Trunome from Chennai pitched post-transplant care on Shark Tank India Season 2 and got a deal from four sharks. Transplant patients need lifelong monitoring and medicines, and hospitals struggle to follow up.
angle: Organ transplant patients need regular tests, medicine management and quick response to problems. A care programme with hospitals and transplant surgeons improves outcomes. Patients pay for peace of mind, and hospitals value partners who reduce readmissions.
